collection: Five individually source-checked public news references found through targeted web research. This is a convenience sample, not a complete crime feed or independent location validation.
limitations: No independently validated street incidents or current field observations are available. Search bounds select wider-area references; they do not locate an event. News selection and reporting are incomplete. Historical reports remain historical. Source review establishes what a publisher reported, not that an allegation is proven.

sources.name: The Times of India · Kolkata reporting

reuse.terms: Linked public references and short original factual summaries only. No open dataset license or publisher partnership is claimed. Article text, photographs, victim identities and residential addresses are not redistributed.

scopes.name: Salt Lake research area · priority Sectors II and V

incidents.public_summary: A student alleged assault at a campus gate and CK-CL ground. Police sought camera footage. The account spans multiple places.

location.label: CK-CL ground and a Sector V campus gate
location.reason: The source describes more than one place; no incident point or adjoining pedestrian street has been independently established.

reviews.method: Read original publisher report; retain date precision and multiple-location ambiguity.

incidents.public_summary: Police reported arrests after a student's complaint about assault inside a Sector V college. The report concerns campus premises.

location.label: Sector V · campus interior
location.reason: An incident inside a campus cannot be assigned to a passing pedestrian's public walking street. The complaint station is not the incident location.

reviews.method: Read original publisher report; distinguish incident premises from reporting station.

incidents.public_summary: A fatal bike–truck collision was reported near the Sector V bridge towards Nicco Park. This is transport history, not a verified walking-street crime pin.

location.label: Sector V bridge towards Nicco Park
location.reason: The bridge approach and road level have not been independently located. A vehicle collision does not establish pedestrian crime exposure.

reviews.method: Read original publisher report; distinguish transport incident from pedestrian crime and preserve location ambiguity.

incidents.public_summary: Chain snatching during a morning walk was reported at a residential entrance in BG Block, Sector II. It remains historical area context.

location.label: BG Block · Sector II
location.reason: No private residential entrance is published. The nearby escape passage is not the incident site. The report is older than the 365-day comparison window.

reviews.method: Read original publisher report; preserve historical date, withhold residential detail, and distinguish escape path from incident location.

incidents.public_summary: A complaint alleged harassment and assault when a group left a Sector V bar. The venue and exact public-street section were not identified.

location.label: Sector V · unnamed bar exit
location.reason: The source leaves the venue and street unresolved. This historical event cannot be assigned to every Sector V lane.

reviews.method: Read original publisher report; keep venue ambiguity and historical date instead of generating coordinates.
